Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, if you have a free Monster Zone, Special Summon 1 random Zombie monster from your GY in Attack Position. my_pride_and_soul@1.name: My Pride and Soul
my_pride_and_soul@1.text: Dragon monsters you control gain 800 ATK/DEF. Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during your Battle Phase. At the start of the Duel: Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Deck in Attack Position, then add 1 card that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, when a "Blue-Eyes" monster you control is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand, Deck or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (c:IsRace(RACE_DRAGON)) end) e:SetValue(800) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (c:IsRace(RACE_DRAGON)) end) e:SetValue(800) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_ACTIVATE) e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET) e:SetTargetRange(0,1)
e:SetCondition(function() return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsBattlePhase() end)
e:SetValue(function(e,re,tp) return re:IsHasType(EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE) and re:IsActiveType(TYPE_TRAP) end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local used=-1
local function eyes(c,e,tp) return c:IsMonster() and (c:IsSetCard(0xdd) or c:IsCode(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139)) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) end
local function search(c) return (c:IsCode(17655904,23995346,34627841,73398797) or c:ListsCode(89631139)) and c:IsAbleToHand() end
local s=Effect.GlobalEffect() s:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) s:SetCode(EVENT_STARTUP)
s:SetOperation(function(e,tp)
 local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(eyes,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil,e,tp) local can=#g>0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(0,LOCATION_MZONE)>0
 if can or Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(search,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000299)  end
 if can then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON) local tc=g:Select(0,1,1,nil):GetFirst()
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) end
 local h=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(search,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
 if #h>0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_ATOHAND) local sg=h:Select(0,1,1,nil) Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SendtoHand(sg,0,REASON_EFFECT) Duel.ConfirmCards(1,sg) end
 Duel.ShuffleDeck(0) end)
Duel.RegisterEffect(s,0)
local function lost(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(0) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and (c:IsPreviousSetCard(0xdd) or c:IsCode(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139) or c:IsPreviousCodeOnField(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139)) end
local function dragon(c,e,tp) return c:IsMonster() and c:IsAttribute(ATTRIBUTE_LIGHT) and c:IsRace(RACE_DRAGON) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,true)
 and (c:IsLocation(LOCATION_EXTRA) and Duel.GetLocationCountFromEx(tp,tp,nil,c)>0 or not c:IsLocation(LOCATION_EXTRA) and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0) end
local d=Effect.GlobalEffect() d:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) d:SetCode(EVENT_DESTROYED)
d:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg) return used~=Duel.GetTurnCount() and eg:IsExists(lost,1,nil) and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(dragon,0,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_EXTRA,0,1,nil,e,tp) end)
d:SetOperation(function(e,tp) local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(dragon,0,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,e,tp) if #g==0 then return end
 Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000299)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,94) then return end
 used=Duel.GetTurnCount() Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON) local tc=g:Select(0,1,1,nil):GetFirst()

fusion_time@6.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@6.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end

insect_swarm@10.name: Insect Swarm
insect_swarm@10.text: Insect monsters you control gain 800 ATK/DEF. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if you control a face-up Insect monster: Special Summon 1 "Moth Token" whose ATK/DEF are equal to the combined ATK/DEF of all face-up Insect monsters you control.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (c:IsRace(RACE_INSECT)) end) e:SetValue(800) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (c:IsRace(RACE_INSECT)) end) e:SetValue(800) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_STANDBY) e:SetCountLimit(1) e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and (Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(function(c) return c:IsFaceup() and c:IsRace(RACE_INSECT) end,0,LOCATION_MZONE,0,1,nil)) end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(function(c) return c:IsFaceup() and c:IsRace(RACE_INSECT) end,0,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
 if #g==0 or Duel.GetLocationCount(0,LOCATION_MZONE)<=0 then return end
 local atk,def=g:GetSum(function(c) return math.max(c:GetAttack(),0) end),g:GetSum(function(c) return math.max(c:GetDefense(),0) end)
 if not Duel.IsPlayerCanSpecialSummonMonster(0,190000057,0,TYPES_TOKEN,atk,def,3,RACE_INSECT,ATTRIBUTE_EARTH) then return end
 local token=Duel.CreateToken(0,190000057)
 if Duel.SpecialSummonStep(token,0,0,0,false,false,POS_FACEUP) then
  for _,set in ipairs({{EFFECT_SET_BASE_ATTACK,atk},{EFFECT_SET_BASE_DEFENSE,def}}) do
   local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(token) e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE) e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE) e1:SetCode(set[1]) e1:SetValue(set[2])
   e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD&~RESET_TOFIELD) token:RegisterEffect(e1)
  end
 end
 Duel.SpecialSummonComplete() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

fusion_time@54.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@54.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

  e:SetValue(function(e,c)
   local total=0
   for _,bonus in ipairs({c:GetCardEffect(code)}) do

     local value=bonus:GetValue()
     if type(value)=='function' then value=value(bonus,c) end
     if type(value)=='number' and value>0 then total=total+value end
    end
   end
   return total
  end)
  Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0)
 end
end

cursed_graceful_skull_dice@77.name: Graceful & Skull Dice
cursed_graceful_skull_dice@77.text: The first time you roll a die each turn: gain LP equal to the result x100. Your face-up monsters lose ATK equal to the result x100 until the end of this turn.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local turn=-1 do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_TOSS_DICE)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return ep==0 and (ev&0xff)>0 and turn~=Duel.GetTurnCount() end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) turn=Duel.GetTurnCount() local v=(Duel.GetDiceResult() or 0)*100 if v<=0 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000206)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000206) Duel.Recover(0,v,REASON_EFFECT)
if not RogueAlmighty then for c in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsFaceup,0,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil):Iter() do local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c) e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE) e1:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK) e1:SetValue(-v) e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD|RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END) c:RegisterEffect(e1) end end end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end end

demonic_pact@77.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact@77.text: Recover half the LP cost whenever you pay it for an Archfiend card. If Pandemonium prevents an Archfiend monster’s Standby Phase cost, recover half of the prevented amount.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local standby_costs={}
 local function queue(c,amount,is_standby_monster)
  local refund=math.floor((tonumber(amount) or 0)/2)
  if refund<=0 then return end
  if is_standby_monster and standby_costs[c] then return end
  if is_standby_monster then standby_costs[c]=true end
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000251) Duel.Recover(0,refund,REASON_EFFECT)
 end
 local paid=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 paid:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 paid:SetCode(EVENT_PAY_LPCOST)
 paid:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND) then
   local upkeep=Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) and c:IsMonster()
   queue(c,ev,upkeep)
  end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(paid,0)
 -- Pandemonium raises this event (its ID + 1; its search uses its ID) from its cost-replacement
 -- operation because replaced upkeep payments do not emit EVENT_PAY_LPCOST.
 local prevented=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 prevented:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 prevented:SetCode(EVENT_CUSTOM+94585853)
 prevented:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsControler(0) and c:IsMonster() and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND)
   and Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) then queue(c,ev,true) end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(prevented,0)
 local reset=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 reset:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 reset:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_STANDBY)
 reset:SetCondition(function() return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 end)
 reset:SetOperation(function() standby_costs={} end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(reset,0)
end

my_pride_and_soul@83.text: Dragon monsters you control gain 800 ATK/DEF. Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during your Battle Phase. At the start of the Duel: Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Deck in Attack Position, then add 1 card that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, when a "Blue-Eyes" monster you control is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand, Deck or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

e:SetCondition(function() return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsBattlePhase() end)
e:SetValue(function(e,re,tp) return re:IsHasType(EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE) and re:IsActiveType(TYPE_TRAP) end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local used=-1
local function eyes(c,e,tp) return c:IsMonster() and (c:IsSetCard(0xdd) or c:IsCode(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139)) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) end
local function search(c) return (c:IsCode(17655904,23995346,34627841,73398797) or c:ListsCode(89631139)) and c:IsAbleToHand() end
local s=Effect.GlobalEffect() s:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) s:SetCode(EVENT_STARTUP)
s:SetOperation(function(e,tp)
 local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(eyes,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil,e,tp) local can=#g>0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(0,LOCATION_MZONE)>0
 if can or Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(search,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000299)  end
 if can then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON) local tc=g:Select(0,1,1,nil):GetFirst()
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) end
 local h=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(search,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
 if #h>0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_ATOHAND) local sg=h:Select(0,1,1,nil) Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SendtoHand(sg,0,REASON_EFFECT) Duel.ConfirmCards(1,sg) end
 Duel.ShuffleDeck(0) end)
Duel.RegisterEffect(s,0)
local function lost(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(0) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and (c:IsPreviousSetCard(0xdd) or c:IsCode(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139) or c:IsPreviousCodeOnField(53347303,53183600,23995346,89631139)) end
local function dragon(c,e,tp) return c:IsMonster() and c:IsAttribute(ATTRIBUTE_LIGHT) and c:IsRace(RACE_DRAGON) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,true)
 and (c:IsLocation(LOCATION_EXTRA) and Duel.GetLocationCountFromEx(tp,tp,nil,c)>0 or not c:IsLocation(LOCATION_EXTRA) and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0) end
local d=Effect.GlobalEffect() d:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) d:SetCode(EVENT_DESTROYED)
d:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg) return used~=Duel.GetTurnCount() and eg:IsExists(lost,1,nil) and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(dragon,0,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_EXTRA,0,1,nil,e,tp) end)
d:SetOperation(function(e,tp) local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(dragon,0,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,e,tp) if #g==0 then return end
 Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000299)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,94) then return end
 used=Duel.GetTurnCount() Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON) local tc=g:Select(0,1,1,nil):GetFirst()
 local deck=tc:IsLocation(LOCATION_DECK) Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,true,true,POS_FACEUP) if deck then Duel.ShuffleDeck(0) end end)
Duel.RegisterEffect(d,0) end

local s=Effect.GlobalEffect() s:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) s:SetCode(EVENT_STARTUP)
s:SetOperation(function(e,tp)
 local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(eyes,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil,e,tp) local can=#g>0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(1,LOCATION_MZONE)>0
 if can or Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(search,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000299)  end
 if can then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000299) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,0,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON) local tc=g:Select(1,1,1,nil):GetFirst()
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000299) Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) end

fusion_time@97.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@97.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

s:

do
 local id=0x7f34a1
 local coin=Effect.GlobalEffect() coin:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) coin:SetCode(EVENT_TOSS_COIN_NEGATE)
 coin:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep) return ep==0 and Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)==0 end)
 coin:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev) if Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)>0 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000225)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000225) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,id) then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000225)  Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(0,id,RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END,0,1) Duel.TossCoin(ep,ev) end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(coin,0)
 local dice=Effect.GlobalEffect() dice:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) dice:SetCode(EVENT_TOSS_DICE_NEGATE)
 dice:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep) return ep==0 and Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)==0 end)
 dice:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev) if Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)>0 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000225)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000225) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,id) then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000225)  Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(0,id,RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END,0,1) Duel.TossDice(ep,ev&0xff,ev>>16) end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(dice,0)
end

field_amplifier@104.text: Double ATK/DEF increases applied by the effects of face-up Field Spells you control. ATK/DEF decreases are unchanged.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 for _,code in ipairs({EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK,EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE}) do
  local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(code) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE)
  e:SetValue(function(e,c)
   local total=0
   for _,bonus in ipairs({c:GetCardEffect(code)}) do
    local source=bonus:GetHandler()
    if bonus~=e and source and source:IsControler(0) and source:IsLocation(LOCATION_FZONE) and source:IsFaceup() and source:IsType(TYPE_FIELD) and not source:IsDisabled() then
     local value=bonus:GetValue()
     if type(value)=='function' then value=value(bonus,c) end
     if type(value)=='number' and value>0 then total=total+value end
    end
   end
   return total
  end)
  Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0)
 end
end

fusion_time@104.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@104.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

s:

 local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(function(c) return c:IsFaceup() and c:IsCanAddCounter(COUNTER_SPELL,1) end,0,LOCATION_ONFIELD,0,nil)
 if #g==0 then break end

  c=g:Select(0,0,1,nil):GetFirst() end
 if not c or not c:AddCounter(COUNTER_SPELL,1) then break end
end end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

guardians_armory@88.text: Start each Duel with a random Guardian monster and its corresponding Equip Spell in your hand. Equipped monsters you control gain 500 ATK. A Guardian monster you control cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's card effects while its corresponding Equip Spell is face-up on the field.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (#c:GetEquipGroup()>0) end) e:SetValue(500) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local pairs={{73544866,68427465},{10755153,95638658},{74367458,69243953},
                {47150851,32022366},{9633505,95515060},{46037213,21900719}}
 local function protected(e,c)
  for _,pair in ipairs(pairs) do
   if c:IsFaceup() and c:IsCode(pair[1]) then
    return Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(function(s) return s:IsFaceup() and s:IsCode(pair[2]) and s:IsSpell() end,
      0,LOCATION_SZONE,LOCATION_SZONE,1,nil)
   end
  end
  return false
 end
 -- Only the opponent's effects (Discord, 2026-11-14): your own Equip Spells must still reach the Guardian.
 local t=Effect.GlobalEffect() t:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) t:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET)
 t:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) t:SetTarget(protected) t:SetValue(function(e,re,rp) return rp==1 end) Duel.RegisterEffect(t,0)
 local d=t:Clone() d:SetCode(EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT) Duel.RegisterEffect(d,0)
 local s=Effect.GlobalEffect() s:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) s:SetCode(EVENT_STARTUP)
 s:SetOperation(function(e)
  e:Reset()
  local pair=pairs[Duel.GetRandomNumber(1,#pairs)]
  for _,code in ipairs(pair) do
   if not Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(Card.IsCode,0,LOCATION_HAND,0,1,nil,code) then
    local c=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsCode,0,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil,code):GetFirst()
    if not c then c=Duel.CreateToken(0,code) end
    Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000311) Duel.SendtoHand(c,0,REASON_RULE)
   end
  end
 end) Duel.RegisterEffect(s,0)
end

fusion_time@103.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@103.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end
